user.title: Choose a Hue bridge
user.description: Use a bridge already configured in Home Assistant, or pair another bridge. Only Festavia lights will be offered.

link.title: Authorize Festavia Studio
link.description: Verify {name} ({bridge_id}), then press its physical link button and select Submit. Certificate fingerprint: {fingerprint}

fixtures.title: Choose your Festavia lights
fixtures.description: Bridge mode uses Hue gradient points. Individual puck effects require an ESP32-C6 and a verified fixture model. Stop playback before changing fixtures or mode.

device.title: Connect your ESP32-C6
device.description: Enter the HTTPS address and credentials from its first USB installation. Updates after that use Wi-Fi. Leave an existing token or fingerprint empty to keep it.

network.title: Join the Hue Zigbee network
network.description: In the Hue app, open Settings → Lights → Add lights → Search. Choose its network here. The bridge remains the Zigbee coordinator.

joined.title: Wait for the ESP32 to join
joined.description: Allow about 30 seconds, then Submit to verify the connection and read the fixture size.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Festavia authorization
reauth_confirm.description: Leave a key/token empty to keep it. A linked Hue integration supplies its current key automatically. This updates credentials for the same bridge and ESP32; it does not change lights or mode.

device_recover.title: Restore previous playback
device_recover.description: Restore the appearance captured before playback, then release the previous controller. Keep the bridge, ESP32 and lights powered and reachable.

orphan_recover.title: Restore previous playback
orphan_recover.description: Restore the appearance captured before playback, then release the previous controller. Keep the bridge, ESP32 and lights powered and reachable.

recover.title: Restore previous playback
recover.description: Restore the appearance captured before playback, then release the previous controller. Keep the bridge, ESP32 and lights powered and reachable.

recover_missing.title: Recover after removing Hue lights
recover_missing.description: Only use this after a captured light has been permanently removed or replaced in Hue. Restore every captured light still present on the original bridge and discard recovery ONLY for missing Hue resource IDs. Reconnect reachable equipment first, then confirm. After recovery, choose the replacement lights in Reconfigure → Lights and control mode.

data.confirm: I confirm missing Hue lights were permanently removed or replaced

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach this Hue bridge. Check its address, authorization and network access.
error.link_required: Press the Hue bridge link button and try again.
error.device_connection: Cannot verify this ESP32-C6. Check its address, token, fingerprint and that playback is stopped.
error.invalid_selection: This selection is not supported. Native mode needs one verified LCX030 fixture. Bridge mode supports other Festavia models.
error.network_failed: Could not join or verify the network. Open Add lights → Search in Hue, then try again.
error.stop_first: Stop and restore the current effect before changing the installation.
error.invalid_auth: Authorization was rejected. Check the key or token.
error.certificate_changed: The certificate changed. Verify the device identity in Reconfigure.
error.recovery_failed: Restoration could not be confirmed. Check connections and authorization, then retry; recovery data has been retained.
error.confirm_required: Confirm that the missing lights were permanently removed or replaced.

control.title: Playback ownership
control.description: Yield Studio playback when Hue changes the selected light. If Home Assistant or its Hue event connection is lost, playback stops so Hue can control it. Start Studio again explicitly when you want it back.

hue_effect_active.message: This light is running a Hue gradient scene or effect that Studio cannot restore yet. Set a solid color or white using its Hue light controls, then press Play.

fixture_changed.message: Another controller changed this light during startup. Stop the competing automation and press Play again.

takeover_update_required.message: Update the ESP32 firmware to enable Hue takeover, or turn off Allow Hue takeover in the device configuration.

takeover_unavailable.message: The Hue event connection is unavailable. Reconnect the bridge, or turn off Allow Hue takeover to run without it.

animated_palette_count.message: Animations support up to {limit} colors. Choose Static repeat for a larger palette.

snake_count.message: Choose 1–{limit} snake colors, leaving at least one background puck in each repeat.

recovery_pending.title: Festavia restoration is unfinished
recovery_pending.description: Reconnect the original bridge and ESP32. If Festavia Studio is still configured, use Reconfigure → Recover playback, or reload it to retry restoration. If it was removed, add Festavia Studio again and choose the original bridge and lights; setup offers recovery before taking control. Private credentials and the captured state were retained. Keep the component files installed until recovery is complete.
